description: Queue an iOS acceptance run of an uploaded build on a simulator: a plain-language task, or an existing use case or test case. Returns the queued run; poll muggle-remote-ios-run-get until isFinished.

artifactDigest.description: sha256 digest of an uploaded build (artifact.digest from muggle-remote-ios-build-upload or -list)

deviceType.description: Simulator device type to run on, e.g. iPhone-15

maxSteps.description: Most agent steps before the run stops with a machinery status

projectId.description: Muggle project ID (UUID) the iOS build or run belongs to

secretRefs.description: Names of project secrets the host resolves at claim time, such as a login password; never the secret values

task.description: Plain-language goal for the agent to verify in the app

testCaseId.description: Existing test case to run instead of a free-form task

useCaseId.description: Existing use case to run instead of a free-form task

name: muggle-remote-ios-run-create
